title: Implement read-schema backend endpoint
description: Implement the backend endpoint that introspects the PostgreSQL schema and returns structured data for the frontend to render as a diagram.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend endpoint accepts active connection parameters
Backend returns tables, columns, data types
Backend returns primary keys, foreign keys
Backend returns data in structured format

evidence: Fixed backend/src/routes/read-schema.ts: removed incorrect mapper callback from groupByConstraint() calls for primaryKeys and uniqueConstraints (the function already returns { constraintName, columns } shape)

Fixed backend/src/routes/read-schema.test.ts: replaced declare-module pg mock pattern causing TS2451/TS2614 errors with vi.mocked(Client) pattern matching test-connection.test.ts; removed duplicate vi import; added as unknown as Client cast

Fixed backend/src/__tests__/read-schema.integration.test.ts: added ! non-null assertions on .find() results for columns, foreign keys, indexes, and projUKs[0]
